segments.thag1.10:1.1: “Vihari apekkhaṃ idha vā huraṃ vā, yo vedaūū samito yatatto;
segments.thag1.10:1.3: Sabbesu dhammesu anūpalitto, lokassa jaññā udayabbayañcā”ti.
segments.thag1.10:1.5: Itthaṃ sudaṃ āyasmā puṇṇamāso thero gāthaṃ abhāsitthāti.
segments.thag1.10:2.3: Mantāṇiputto dabbo ca, sītavaniyo ca bhalliyo;
